headword: {節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}

definitions.explanation: An invertebrate animal with a hard external skeleton and jointed legs. The group includes insects, spiders, crustaceans, and centipedes.

examples.japanese: {昆虫|こんちゅう}は{節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
エビやカニも{節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Shrimp and crabs are also arthropods.

examples.japanese: {節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ}は{地球上|ちきゅうじょう}で{最|もっと}も{種類|しゅるい}が{多|おお}い{動物|どうぶつ}のグループだ。
examples.english: Arthropods are the most species-rich group of animals on Earth.

notes:
Composed of {節足|せっそく} (jointed legs) + {動物|どうぶつ} (animal). A biology term for invertebrates with a hard exoskeleton and segmented, jointed legs.

INCLUDES:
- {昆虫|こんちゅう}: insects
- クモ: spiders
- {甲殻類|こうかくるい}: crustaceans

RELATED WORDS:
- {無脊椎|むせきつい}{動物|どうぶつ}: invertebrate — the broader category to which {節足|せっそく}{動物|どうぶつ} belongs
- {外骨格|がいこっかく}: exoskeleton — the hard outer covering of an arthropod
